messages:
Emma (oncall): paging: spike of 5xx/timeouts from edge-us-west-2 starting ~09:12 UTC. Dashboard shows ~6% error rate, most are TLS handshake failures in the gateway. paging @Raj @Marta :rotating_light:
Incident Bot: Page created: SEV2 - Elevated TLS handshake failures - edge-us-west-2 - triggered by alerting-rule/gateway-tls-handshake-rate
Emma (oncall): logs from gateway (snippet):
```
2026-07-12T09:12:18Z gateway[proxy]: tls: failed to parse private key: unsupported private key type
2026-07-12T09:12:18Z gateway[proxy]: tls: handshake error from 10.2.3.45: remote error: tls: internal error
2026-07-12T09:12:19Z gateway[proxy]: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```
Emma (oncall): Deploy Bot shows a rotator job ran at 09:10 and uploaded new cert/key bundle (job id abc123). I suspect the new key is in a different encoding/format.
Deploy Bot: cert-rotator job abc123 completed at 2026-07-12T09:10:21Z (targets: edge-us-west-2, edge-us-west-2-canary).
Marta (Infra): I pushed that bundle this morning. Looking at the key: it might be PKCS8 vs expected PKCS1. Quick grep shows loader error: "failed to parse private key: ASN1 structure too large / unsupported key format"
Raj (SRE): capturing full logs + retracing deploy. Running a targeted check across edge fleet to count how many hosts failed to load certs. Also checking mTLS client failures for services using mutual auth.
Sophie (Support): affect report from frontlines: customers reporting ‚Something went wrong‘ on a subset of requests; primarily apps routing through us-west-2. Estimated impacted customers: ~8 enterprise tenants; some API retries visible.
Emma (oncall): Mitigation proposal (fast):
  1) pause/stop further rotator rollouts (preventing more edges from getting the bundle)
  2) fail traffic away from edge-us-west-2 to us-east and eu-west while we triage
  3) rollback rotator bundle to previous known-good (abc119)
  4) prepare hotfix to either convert key format or update loader to accept both formats (short term: reformat keys)
Raj (SRE): agree. I'm executing step 2 now: modifying routing policy to remove us-west-2 from primary pool. Command: `infra-routing set-region-priority gateway remove us-west-2` (mock)
Emma (oncall): running health check after routing change: `curl -I https://gateway.redwood.example/health --resolve gateway.redwood.example:443:52.12.34.56` -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK from us-east, errors drop in rollout view.
Marta (Infra): I can convert the uploaded private key from PKCS1 -> PKCS8 or vice-versa. Conversion command (example):
```
# to PKCS1 (RSA) from PKCS8 (if needed)
openssl rsa -in key-pkcs8.pem -out key-pkcs1.pem
# to PKCS8 (modern) without encryption
openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -nocrypt -in key-pkcs1.pem -out key-pkcs8.pem
```
Marta (Infra): however our loader historically expects PKCS1 unencrypted keys. The rotator recently started outputting PKCS8 by default after a dependency bump. I'm preparing a small job to reformat the bundle and re-upload to canary nodes only first.
Leo (ProdEng): patching the loader to accept both formats would be ideal long-term but too risky to push across fleet right now. Reformat + canary -> then gradual rollout.
Raj (SRE): I've paused the rotator service and issued a temp hold on scheduled rotations. Also increased connection reuse on remaining edges to reduce handshakes. Monitoring graphs now.
Deploy Bot: rollback to bundle abc119 initiated at 2026-07-12T09:21:33Z, completed in canary; full rollback kicked at 09:22:10Z (targets: edge-us-west-2).
Sophie (Support): Notifying affected customers: AcmeCorp, BrightData, NimbusAnalytics. Draft message: "We're investigating intermittent gateway errors; we've rerouted traffic and are working on a fix. We'll follow up with a root cause and timeline." Send? :thumbsup:
Emma (oncall): send the message. Also add a public status page note (no-blame) and indicate mitigations are in progress.
Marta (Infra): reformat job ready. I'll re-upload to canary host group (edge-us-west-2-canary) after 1 minute of observation post-rollback.
Emma (oncall): Current numbers: error rate down from 6% -> 0.6% after routing + rollback. Keep monitoring for TLS renegotiation churn.
Raj (SRE): I'll take oncall after 09:45 and run 2hr watch; assigning handoff now. Emma -> Raj handoff :handshake: 
Emma (oncall): handing off to @Raj. Postmortem owner: Marta. Need RCA on why rotator switched key format (dependency/regression) and why loader didn't accept both formats. Follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-07-13 14:00 UTC.
Incident Bot: Incident updated: status = mitigated, impact = partial, owner = Marta, postmortem scheduled.
Sophie (Support): closing customer notifications loop; will escalate to account managers for the impacted tenants.
Marta (Infra): quick notes for RCA: rotator now defaulting to openssl pkcs8 output after package bump in release 2026-07-10; loader hadn't been updated. Will include diff and proposed fix in postmortem.
Raj (SRE): monitoring shows error rate stable ~0.2% baseline. Will keep alerts enabled and watch for regressions. If anything flares, re-open page.
Emma (oncall): thanks all. Good triage, clean rollback strategy. Postmortem owners to include timeline, conversion script, and deployment checklist to avoid key-format mismatch in future.
Marta (Infra): assigning follow-ups: convert existing stored bundles -> script + runbook; add pre-deploy key-format check in rotator CI; add automated smoke TLS handshake check post-rotation.
Emma (oncall): end of thread for the page; leaving follow-ups in #incidents-postmortems.
